domain.mutation: Inputs and published state are immutable for the duration of a call; only fresh local arrays, maps, sets, records, and opaque replacement-plan registrations may be mutated.
domain.dependencies: Quantity, measurement, identity, catalog, and common event-construction operations mean the exact separately registered family equations named by this certificate.
domain.excluded: Proxies, accessors, subclasses, monkey-patched built-ins, structurally forged catalogs/plans, cyclic values, concurrent input mutation, clocks, storage I/O, and application callbacks other than the separately checked correction wrapper are outside this V domain.
